channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker

item.title: Israeli strikes kill at least four, including children, across Gaza Strip
item.description: Bombings take place as Hamas officials meet with Qatari, Egyptian and Turkish mediators in Cairo to discuss truce.

item.title: Attack on northwest Pakistan police post kills 11 officers
item.description: Fifteen attackers were also killed during the hours-long raid in Pakistan's northwestern Hangu district.

item.title: Several children killed and wounded in Israeli attacks across Gaza
item.description: Israeli strikes hit multiple areas across Gaza overnight, including tents sheltering displaced families in al-Mawasi.

item.title: Why is Saudi Arabia forming a coalition to protect the Red Sea?
item.description: The alliance aims to defend shipping from attacks by Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen.

item.title: Poland says Russian missile breaches NATO airspace
item.description: Poland says a Russian missile landed inside Polish territory, breaching NATO airspace during a Russian attack on Ukraine

item.title: US hits multiple targets in Iran as IRGC pledges retaliation: What we know
item.description: Jordan said it intercepted missiles shortly after the US struck Iranian sites including Qeshm and Bushehr.

item.title: Photos: Zelenskyy urges ‘protection of life’ amid deadly Russian attacks
item.description: Russia launches more than 70 missiles and 280 drones in a major attack on Ukraine that kills at least eight people.

item.title: US strikes cause extensive damage on Iran’s Qeshm Island
item.description: Video from Iran's Qeshm Island shows widespread damage following US attacks.

item.title: In the waters off Malaysia, Iranian oil sales continue despite blockade
item.description: A large anchorage area off the coast of Malaysia is a major marketplace for sanctioned oil.

item.title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
item.description: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.
